title: Markdown Cheatsheet
source:
# Markdown Cheatsheet

| Syntax | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `**bold**` | **bold** |
| `*italic*` | *italic* |
| `[link](url)` | a link |
| `> quote` | a blockquote |

```js
function hello(name) {
  return `Hi, ${name}`;
}
```

Back to [[Welcome]].
